svg.title: S2.2 · The stall that opens one at a time: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 15: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service stall (one stable address); StatefulSet stall (stall-0 Running, not Ready, stall-1, stall-2: not created). Also: Readiness probe (asks port 8080, stall listens on 5678). Your mission: Three stalls ordered, one exists. Why?
